ev.q: Thirty-nine cases were identified among club members with diarrhea and four among club workers
Common symptoms included diarrhea in 95% of patients, abdominal cramps in 70%, and fever in 56%.
Thirty-one (72%) persons sought medical care, and 10 (23%) were hospitalized.
